name: blog-index-sidebar
title: Blog index with sidebar
description: A blog front page in two columns: your post list beside a sticky sidebar of search, topics with counts, popular posts and a slot for a sign-up.
docs: Pass a PostFeed, a BlogList or your own list as children. Give searchAction for a plain GET form, or onSearch inside a Client Component; it also gets an empty string when the field is cleared, so reset your list there. The sidebar sticks under your header, and one taller than the window pins by its bottom edge so the last widget stays in view. Set --sticky-top to your header's height, for example className="[--sticky-top:4rem]".
